subtitle: Design, implement and audit a Safety Management System for UAS operations, mapped to FAA Part 5 and ICAO Annex 19.
description: A complete SMS course for unmanned aircraft operators, built around the four pillars of ICAO Doc 9859 and FAA 14 CFR Part 5: Safety Policy, Safety Risk Management, Safety Assurance and Safety Promotion. Each module has a short video lesson, a diagram, written notes and a transcript, and ends with a knowledge check. The capstone gives you an editable SMS Manual and a 5x5 Risk Register, and a 50-question final assessment (80% to pass) closes the course. Syllabus mapped to FAA 14 CFR Part 5 and AC 120-92D and ICAO Annex 19 and Doc 9859. Independent training, not affiliated with or endorsed by any aviation authority.
learningOutcomes: Explain how aviation safety thinking evolved and analyze an accident with the Swiss Cheese model
Map the regulatory architecture from ICAO Annex 19 to FAA 14 CFR Part 5 and AC 120-92D, and know when an SMS is required or voluntary
Write a Safety Policy Statement and define accountabilities, reporting lines and Stop-Work Authority
Build an Emergency Response Plan for fly-aways, battery fires and collisions
Run the five-step SRM process with a 5x5 risk matrix and the Hierarchy of Controls
Set up SPIs, hazard reporting, Management of Change and root cause analysis
Build a Just Culture with closed-loop safety communication
Produce a working SMS Manual and Risk Register for your own operation
